column1: # QEMU-only logical twin of the secure A/B layout.
# Offsets and sizes must stay identical to the production table
# flags are omitted because this state-machine test deliberately runs without
# Flash Encryption/eFuse provisioning. Using an encrypted partition while
# flash encryption is disabled routes writes through esp_flash_write_encrypted
# and does not model durable production part0 semantics across reboot.
